column2: Gorton and Denton by-election: questionnaire to all candidates, constituency-only send (181 people).
column3: 25% acted. Reform's Matt Goodwin signed; the Green winner and Labour ignored us. With no imprint, we could publish only to our list.

column2: Makerfield by-election: Andy Burnham held the seat.
column3: 188 signatures, 6 new members. Lesson: judge by-election campaigns on answers and outcome, not list growth.

column2: Clacton by-election: Nigel Farage re-elected without answering; 4 of 21 contactable candidates replied.
column3: The contact tool worked but its actions were not in Looker. A named target without a published consequence for silence changed nothing.

column2: Keir Starmer resigned as MP for Holborn and St Pancras; poll set for 8 October.
column3: The seat was an assisted suicide Aye.

column2: Assisted suicide Bill fell 270 to 286 with the seat vacant.
column3: Gives the by-election a concrete life stake: one of 16.

column2: Brief drafted: eight questions to all 15 candidates, constituency segment, grid published under imprint on 6 October.
column3: Applies all three lessons: publish to voters, track the tool, and make silence visible before polling day.
